description: Fetch disaster and emergency supplemental spending (COVID-19, hurricanes, infrastructure law, etc.) broken down by agency, CFDA assistance program, recipient, or geography. Use the dimension parameter to select the breakdown axis: overview (top-level totals), agency, cfda, recipient, or geography. Filter by DEF codes (Disaster/Emergency Funding codes) to isolate a specific emergency appropriation. DEF codes appear in usaspending_get_award account_obligations_by_defc and usaspending_get_agency def_codes fields.

dimension.description: Breakdown axis: overview (top-level totals and DEF code funding), agency (by awarding agency), cfda (by assistance program), recipient (by recipient), geography (by state/county)

filters.description: Filters — def_codes is required for all non-overview dimensions (agency, cfda, recipient, geography)

def_codes.description: DEF codes to filter by (e.g., ["L", "M", "N", "O", "P"] for COVID-19). Required for all dimensions except overview — the upstream API returns HTTP 422 when omitted for agency, cfda, recipient, and geography breakdowns. DEF codes appear in usaspending_get_agency def_codes fields.

geo_layer.description: Geographic layer for geography dimension (state or county)

limit.description: Maximum results per page (1–100). Applies to the agency, cfda, recipient, and geography dimensions; geography pages through its areas ranked by aggregated_amount, highest first. Ignored for overview.

spending_type.description: Data type for the agency dimension: award (award-level obligations and outlays) or total (includes direct non-award spending, plus total budgetary resources). Ignored for cfda, recipient, and overview, which report award-level amounts either way; the geography dimension is not user-controllable and always reports obligation-based amounts.

name: usaspending_disaster_spending

cap.description: recipient: the result-set ceiling the upstream applied. geography: the page size (limit).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: recipient: why the total is a cap and how to bring the set under it. geography: how many areas rank below this page and how to reach them.

face_value_of_loans.description: Face value of loan guarantees in USD

funding_by_def_code.description: Funding amounts broken down by DEF code (emergency appropriation)

items.description: DEF code funding entry with amount and public law reference

amount.description: Funding amount in USD for this DEF code

total_budget_authority.description: Total budget authority in USD across all emergency supplementals

items.description: Disaster spending breakdown entry by dimension (agency, CFDA, recipient, or geography)

aggregated_amount.description: Obligation-based spending amount in USD (geography dimension)

code.description: Code (agency code, CFDA number, DEF code, etc.)

display_name.description: Geographic display name (geography dimension); absent on the unattributed row

face_value_of_loan.description: Face value of loan guarantees in USD (loans spending_type)

id.description: Item ID. On the recipient dimension, a recipient hash ID for usaspending_get_recipient — the recipient-level (-R) ID when the recipient has several.

per_capita.description: Obligation-based spending per capita in USD (geography dimension)

population.description: Population of the geographic area (geography dimension)

shape_code.description: Geographic code (geography dimension). Absent on the unattributed row: spending with no recorded place of performance, which still ranks and counts as an area.

total_budgetary_resources.description: Total budgetary resources in USD for this row (agency dimension with spending_type total)

shown.description: Number of results returned on this page.

spending_type.description: Data type returned — award/total for agency; the requested value echoed for cfda and recipient, whose amounts do not vary with it; obligation for geography; spending for overview

totalCount.description: Total items for paginated dimensions (when available)

totals.description: Totals across every matching row, as reported upstream — not a sum of this page. Present for the agency, cfda, and recipient dimensions; the members depend on dimension and spending_type. Absent for overview and geography.

award_count.description: Number of awards across the result set (award-level breakdowns)

obligation.description: Obligations in USD across the whole matching result set

outlay.description: Outlays in USD across the whole matching result set

total_budgetary_resources.description: Total budgetary resources in USD across the result set (agency dimension with spending_type total)

truncated.description: recipient: true when the upstream capped the reachable result set rather than counting it. geography: true when more areas rank below this page.

truncationCeiling.description: geography: the lowest aggregated_amount on this page — no area on a later page has a higher one.

title: Disaster and Emergency Spending
